clock_and_reset_waveform.ACLK: Single rising-edge clock per AXI interface.
clock_and_reset_waveform.ARESETn: Active LOW. Async assert; sync deassert. After ARESETn=HIGH, earliest rising ACLK edge that VALID may be asserted = next rising edge.

handshake_waveforms.sequence: Source asserts VALID at T1. Destination asserts READY at T2. Transfer occurs at T3 (rising ACLK after both asserted). Source must hold info stable from T1 through T3.
Destination asserts READY at T1. Source asserts VALID at T2. Transfer occurs at T3 (single-cycle transfer once VALID is recognized).

handshake_waveforms.case: VALID with READY same cycle (Figure A3-4)
handshake_waveforms.sequence: Both VALID and READY happen to assert at T1. Transfer occurs at T2 (next rising ACLK).

arrows: ARVALID -> ARREADY (single-headed; can precede or follow)
ARVALID, ARREADY -> RVALID (double-headed; RVALID only after both)

write_AXI3.note: AXI3 BVALID depends only on W handshake + WLAST, NOT on AW handshake.

arrows: AWVALID + AWREADY + WVALID + WREADY + WLAST -> BVALID (double-headed)
write_AXI4_AXI5.note: AXI4/AXI5 adds slave dependency on AW handshake before BVALID can be issued.

narrow_transfer_waveforms.Figure_A3-8: 5 incrementing transfers, start address 0, 8-bit transfers on a 32-bit bus. Each beat uses a different byte lane.
narrow_transfer_waveforms.Figure_A3-9: 3 transfers, start address 4, 32-bit transfers on a 64-bit bus.
narrow_transfer_waveforms.Figure_A3-13: Aligned and unaligned 32-bit transfers on a 32-bit bus (INCR).
narrow_transfer_waveforms.Figure_A3-14: Aligned and unaligned 32-bit transfers on a 64-bit bus (INCR).
narrow_transfer_waveforms.Figure_A3-15: Aligned wrapping 32-bit transfers on a 64-bit bus, length 4.

max_outstanding_rules.same_ID_ordering: All transactions with the same AXI ID must remain in order (request order = response order).
max_outstanding_rules.different_ID_ordering: No ordering constraint between different IDs.
max_outstanding_rules.read_reordering_depth: The number of addresses pending in the slave that can be reordered. A slave that processes all transactions in order has reordering depth 1. Static, defined by the designer.
max_outstanding_rules.no_outstanding_count_in_spec: Spec defines no maximum number of outstanding transactions; an implementation-defined value.

write_response_dependency_rules: AXI3: BVALID may be asserted as soon as W handshake completes + WLAST=1, even before AW handshake. AXI3 slave that does so is non-compliant with AXI4/AXI5.
AXI4/AXI5: BVALID must not be asserted until AW handshake AND W handshake + WLAST are all complete.

The read data reordering depth is the number of addresses pending in the slave that can be reordered. A slave that processes all transactions in order has a read data reordering depth of one. The read data reordering depth is a static value that must be specified by the designer of the slave.
